subject: general
question: In August 2025, who assumed charge as the Director General of the Railway Protection Force (RPF), becoming the first woman to head the 143-year-old central security force?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonali Mishra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonali Mishra**, an officer of the **1993 batch** of the **Indian Police Service (IPS)** from the **Madhya Pradesh cadre**, took charge as the **Director General (DG)** of the **Railway Protection Force (RPF)** in **August 2025**.
 
• She created history by becoming the **first woman** to head the **Railway Protection Force**, a security wing that has been in existence for **143 years**.
 
• Her appointment was formalized following the approval of the **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)**, succeeding **Manoj Yadava**, who retired from the post on **July 31, 2025**.
 
• Before her elevation to this **top designation**, she served as the **Additional Director General (ADG)** of the **Border Security Force (BSF)**, where she commanded the **Eastern Command** headquartered in **Kolkata**.
 
• As the **Director General**, she is responsible for the overall administration of the force, ensuring the **security of railway property** and the safety of **millions of passengers** across the **Indian Railways** network.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Railway Protection Force (RPF):**
 
 
• The **RPF** is a **security force** under the ownership of the **Ministry of Railways**, **Government of India**.
 
• It was originally established in **1872** by various railway companies and was given statutory status under the **RPF Act, 1957**.
 
• In **1985**, it was declared an **Armed Force of the Union** through an amendment to the **RPF Act**.
 
• The force is unique as it has the **legal power** to search, arrest, and prosecute offenses under the **Railway Property (Unlawful Possession) Act, 1966**.
 
 
 
• **Nina Singh:**
 
 
• A **1989-batch IPS officer** of the **Rajasthan cadre**, she became the **first woman** to be appointed as the **Director General** of the **Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)** in **December 2023**.
 
 
 
• **Archana Ramasundram:**
 
 
• She is a **1980-batch IPS officer** who became the **first woman** to head a **Central Armed Police Force (CAPF)** when she was appointed as the **Director General** of the **Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)** in **2016**.
 
 
 
• **Rashmi Shukla:**
 
 
• A **1988-batch IPS officer**, she served as the **Director General** of the **Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)** and later became the **first woman Director General of Police (DGP)** of **Maharashtra** in **January 2024**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Women Empowerment in Security Forces:** The appointment of **Sonali Mishra** reflects the increasing representation of **women** in **leadership roles** within India’s **paramilitary** and **central security forces**.
 
• **Force Mandate:** The **RPF** currently consists of over **70,000 personnel**. They are primarily tasked with the **protection and security** of **Railway Property**, **passenger areas**, and the **well-being of passengers**.
 
• **Historical Context:** The transition of the **RPF** from a "Watch and Ward" staff in **1872** to a **federal armed force** marks its significant **evolution** in the **Indian administrative system**.
 
• **Administrative Control:** Unlike other **Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs)** which fall under the **Ministry of Home Affairs**, the **RPF** functions directly under the **Ministry of Railways**.
